resource.scope: Existing sampled-window observations, left-endpoint weighted, may include pre/post-request margins. Process CPU/RSS includes retained vLLM/LMCache descendants; summed RSS double-counts shared pages and omits gateway/client process memory. Missing endpoint counters stay null; source counters are not DMA time or throughput capacity.

p50.scope: Histogram observation quantile lies within these bucket boundaries; no interpolation or exact token percentile.

p95.scope: Histogram observation quantile lies within these bucket boundaries; no interpolation or exact token percentile.

p99.scope: Histogram observation quantile lies within these bucket boundaries; no interpolation or exact token percentile.

secondary.warning: Proxy includes stream chunking, special-token accounting and final stream/metadata close overhead; one-token outputs are excluded, not zero-filled. Output tokens/s uses full workload duration and can be arrival-limited.
secondary.native_itl_scope: The frozen main sampler did not retain native ITL counters; no retrospective value invented.

admission.scope: Ingress intervals; spare ingress slots do not prove GPU idle time

fairness.limitations: Completed requests only after complete-run success check. Per-conversation tails are descriptive, not normalized slowdown or population estimates. Max-bypass admission bound is not an E2E deadline or native progress guarantee; configured200ms is not a hard maximum queue wait. Observed completion does not prove production starvation freedom.

waits.scope: Complete audited gateway arms. Stages add per request and in means, never in quantiles. Worker queue/CPU are already within prepare. Upstream-to-token includes engine queue, copy, compute and transport; not pure GPU time.

scope: Complete measured full-run integrity+official quality and separate warmup integrity. No SOTA/quality-equivalence/liveness proof. Raw remains private and may be losslessly archived after this audit; every original byte SHA retained.
